sql: SELECT note_date, ticker, category, note FROM terms.collections_notes WHERE as_of = '2026-10-26' AND ticker IN ('WMT', 'TGT', 'KSS', 'AAP', 'PTON', 'W', 'BBWI', 'DKS') ORDER BY ticker, note_date
rows: AAP buyer asks for more headroom for Q4 store resets; order SO-4488 pending.
AAP AP team: payment run delayed by their ERP migration; expects to pay the Sept 25 invoice by Oct 31. Buyer placed SO-4530 meanwhile.
DKS is integrating the Foot Locker banners and asks for an $800,000 limit for Q4 fixtures.
Kohl's disputes $18,400 of the September 7 invoice: damaged pallets at the Ohio DC. Photos requested.
Kohl's paid the September 7 invoice short by the disputed $18,400; dispute still open.
Target confirms Q4 display program volumes in line with last year.
July invoice paid 24 days late. AP contact cited a cash management review.
Wayfair AP: August and September invoices on hold pending 'cash management review'; no payment date given.
Wayfair paid the August invoice (63 days late) after the order hold was escalated. September invoice still open.
